questions.question: What is accounting?
options: The process of recording, analyzing, and reporting financial transactions

questions.question: What is a debit?
options: An entry on the left side of an account
An entry on the right side of an account

questions.question: What is a credit?
options: An entry on the right side of an account
An entry on the left side of an account

questions.question: What is double-entry bookkeeping?
options: A system where every transaction affects at least two accounts
A system where transactions are recorded twice
A system with two sets of books

questions.question: What is a ledger?
options: A collection of accounts showing their balances

questions.question: What is a trial balance?
options: A list of all account balances to check for equality

questions.question: What is an income statement?
options: A report showing revenues, expenses, and net income
A report showing assets and liabilities

questions.question: What is a balance sheet?
options: A report showing assets, liabilities, and owner's equity
A report showing revenues and expenses

questions.question: What is depreciation?
options: The allocation of the cost of an asset over its useful life
The decrease in value of money
The increase in value of assets

questions.question: What is accrual accounting?
options: Recording transactions when they occur, not when cash changes hands
Recording transactions at the end of the year

questions.question: What is cash accounting?
options: Recording transactions only when cash is received or paid

questions.question: What is a general ledger?
options: The main ledger containing all accounts
A ledger for general expenses only

questions.question: What is a chart of accounts?
options: A list of all accounts used by a business
